meta.title: Revised Cra And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Adopt CRA Resolution 6 of 2026 to approve the Sugar House Streetcar S-Line Extension Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City, Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency, and the Utah Transit Authority.
votes.description: Authorizes the Sugar House Streetcar Extension Interlocal Agreement (ILA) between Salt Lake City Corporation, the CRA, and UTA, allowing the project to proceed into and through the construction phase. UTA will own, operate, and maintain the future rail and rail envelope.

votes.motion: Adopt CRA Resolution 7 of 2026 approving the Second Amendment to the Interlocal Agreement with the Utah Inland Port Authority and Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Authorizes the second amendment to the Interlocal Agreement between the CRA of Salt Lake City, Salt Lake City Corporation, and the Utah Inland Port Authority (UIPA), updating the agreement originally entered into October 25, 2022 and first amended July 25, 2024.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the Board of the Community Reinvestment Agency and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Council for a Formal Meeting.
votes.description: Procedural motion to close the CRA board session and transition to the Salt Lake City Council formal meeting.

votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of October 21, 2025, November 18, 2025, and December 9, 2025, as well as the formal meeting minutes of November 18, 2025, and December 2, 2025.
votes.description: Approves five sets of previously pending City Council meeting minutes from late 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 4 of 2026 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing April 1, 2026, as Start by Believing Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Recognizes April 1, 2026 as Start by Believing Day in Salt Lake City, affirming the City's commitment to supporting sexual assault survivors and raising awareness of resources for survivors.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 3 of 2026 with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing March 29, 2026, as Education and Sharing Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: Recognizes March 29, 2026 as Education and Sharing Day in Salt Lake City, affirming the City's shared values of early and lifelong learning, generosity, and community, inspired by the teachings of Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneerson.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items E-1 and E-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the joint public hearing on two grant applications—the Youth Growth and Renovation Grant for Gallivan Center ice rink expansion planning and the Child and Adult Care Food Program Grant for YouthCity—and refers both to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing regarding the SLC Airport Noise Property Disposition at approximately 840 South Gladiola Street.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the disposition of a City-owned FAA noise mitigation property at approximately 840 South Gladiola Street; no further Council action is required.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 6 of 2026, Alley Vacation – Portion East of 519 East Browning Avenue.
votes.description: Vacates a City-owned alley adjacent to properties at 519 and 523-527 East Browning Avenue and nearby addresses, dividing and allocating the vacated portion to abutting property owners; the northern portion of the alley remains open.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Expiration of Land Use Approvals Text Amendment to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed amendments to Title 20 and Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code regarding expiration of land use approvals, and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 2260, 2270, and 2290 East 1300 South to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-1-7000 to MU-3 for three properties at approximately 2260, 2270, and 2290 East 1300 South intended for a 26-unit residential development, and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Sugar House Hotel Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment at approximately 2111 South 1300 East and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from MU-3 to MU-8 and master plan amendment for a hotel development adjacent to Sugar House Park at approximately 2111 South 1300 East, and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on FY 2026-27 Funding Allocations for Federal Housing and Community Development Grants and City Funding Our Future Housing Programs and defer action to a future Council meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed appropriations of CDBG, HOME, ESG, HOPWA, and Funding Our Future housing program funds, along with the Federal One-Year Annual Action Plan for FY 2026-27, and defers Council action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 7 of 2026, Disposition of Alleys and Streets Text Amendment.
votes.description: Amends sections 14.52 and 20.16.050 of the Salt Lake City Code to establish a consistent process for requests to close or vacate City-owned public streets or alleys, and aligns the disposition process with subdivision applications.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 10 of 2026, Fence and Hedge Height Text Amendment.
votes.description: Amends multiple sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to increase front yard fence heights in M-1 and M-1A zones to six feet, clarify clear view standards for fences, walls, and landscaping, and increase rear and side yard fence height maximums to seven feet.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 11 of 2026, Rio Grande Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment.
votes.description: Rezones 32 properties in the Rio Grande District from G-MU to D-4 to allow additional building height, and amends the Downtown Plan to include mid-block walkways within the Rio Grande District and update the Implementation Plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2026, Master Plan and Zoning Map Amendment at Approximately 527, 537, and 539 South 400 East.
votes.description: Rezones properties at approximately 527, 537, and 539 South 400 East from RMF-45 to MU-5 and amends the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map from Medium-High Density Residential to High-Density Mixed-Use to allow a five-story residential building with ground-floor commercial space.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 13 of 2026, amending the text of Title 11 of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to nuisance private property.
votes.description: Amends Title 11 of the Salt Lake City Code to address persistent nuisance activity on private properties and at commercial businesses where owners have failed to curb illegal or disruptive conduct, including unruly gatherings and events.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 14 of 2026, temporarily closing all or portions of City streets adjacent to the Salt Lake City Temple to mitigate unsafe conditions.
votes.description: Temporarily closes City streets adjacent to the Salt Lake City Temple between March 2027 and October 2027 to facilitate public safety and crowd management during the Temple Reopening Celebration.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 7 of 2026 to approve the Sugar House Streetcar S-Line Extension Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City, the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency, and the Utah Transit Authority.
votes.description: Authorizes the Sugar House Streetcar Extension Interlocal Agreement (ILA) at the City Council level, allowing the S-Line extension project to proceed into and through the construction phase with UTA owning, operating, and maintaining the future rail and rail envelope.

votes.motion: Adopt a resolution approving the Second Amendment to the Interlocal Agreement with the Utah Inland Port Authority.
votes.description: Authorizes the second amendment to the Interlocal Agreement between the CRA of Salt Lake City, Salt Lake City Corporation, and the Utah Inland Port Authority at the City Council level, updating the agreement originally entered October 25, 2022.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 8 of 2026, amending Title 17 pertaining to limits on daily water use for new commercial, industrial, and institutional developments.
votes.description: Amends Title 17 of the Salt Lake City Code to clarify that commercial, industrial, and institutional uses are included under the term 'non-residential' for the purpose of the 200,000 gallons per day limit, and limits exemptions to agriculture, schools, certain government facilities, places of worship, and hospitals.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 9 of 2026, enacting a temporary land use regulation pertaining to the daily water use limits on new commercial, industrial, and institutional developments.
votes.description: Enacts a temporary zoning regulation (effective for 180 days) limiting daily water use for all new non-residential developments, with exemptions for agriculture, schools, certain government facilities, places of worship, and hospitals.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, including the appointment of Kim Stowe to the Business Advisory Board and setting public hearing dates for two zoning map amendment ordinances.
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda items: sets April 7, 2026 as the public hearing date for a zoning map amendment at 256 East 300 South and at 1073 South Navajo Street, and approves the appointment of Kim Stowe to the Business Advisory Board for a term ending December 31, 2029.
